checks: All six shipments receive a feasible draft plan.
Closing the bridge changes routes and cost.
Removing refrigeration leaves both medical deliveries unassigned.
An urgent delivery displaces another shipment under the joint constraints.
Competing draft commits reserve each shipment once; the losing transaction conflicts.
Retrying the winning commit is idempotent, and GET restores the saved plan.
Replanning excludes reserved shipments and cannot reuse already dispatched couriers.
Disjoint shipments still conflict when their draft plans need the same physical courier.
Malformed, oversized, forged and unknown inputs are rejected; a fresh batch is independent.
scope: Functional application checks. No version-two REA or recovery-cost result is asserted.
